token.description: Plain secret shown once at creation (`fc_key_<64 hex>`). Never stored or returned again.

AutoConfigApplyRequest.description: Every field is optional: what is left out comes from the benchmark's pick. `video_encoder` and `scale` accept an explicit null (clear it).

include_upload.description: Measure upload first. Default true for `stream`, false for `record`.

max_seconds.description: Time budget for the encoder tests. Default 24.

AutoConfigCandidate.description: One encoder setting that was tested, with its verdict in plain words.

AutoConfigUploadCheck.description: The upload speed check that went before the benchmark.

problem.description: Present only when the platform could not be checked.

AutoConfigView.description: The auto-config state machine, as the REST routes answer and as the `auto_config` live frame carries.

confirm_remaining_s.description: Seconds left to keep the applied settings before they roll back.

watch_remaining_s.description: Seconds left of the first-minute dropped-frame watch.

banned.description: Platforms the ban went through on.

CaptureProblem.description: Active capture source on air showing no usable picture.

oneOf.description: Either 'all' or a single platform id (e.g. 'twitch').

CreatorLinks.description: Creator "My links" configuration. On PUT /api/v1/links, omitted fields and unknown future keys are preserved; an explicit empty string or null clears a string field, and [] or null clears custom.

brand.description: Names a server and key pasted from that platform and applies that platform's stream limits.

key.description: No spaces. Never returned. Needed for RTMP and RTMPS; optional for SRT (stream id), RIST (passphrase) and WebRTC (bearer token).

url.description: rtmp://, rtmps://, srt://, rist:// or https:// (WebRTC WHIP).

LabelsMap.description: Evaluated stream label display strings keyed by LabelSource snake_case name.

everywhere.description: Ban on every connected platform, not only this one.

duration_s.description: Duration in seconds (10..1800), or null for an untimed poll.

info.description: What the stream is about. `title` is required (at most 140 characters, no control characters).

category.description: `{ name, ids? }`: the category's name and, where known, each platform's id.

start_ms.description: Unix milliseconds: in the future, at most a year ahead.

id.description: The platform's id for the scheduled broadcast, when one was made.

note.description: Why there is no broadcast: not connected, none to make there, or the platform said no.

url.description: An https address of it, when the platform gave one.

SettingsPatch.description: Partial update of non-sensitive local application preferences.

id.description: A catalog item id (3 to 80 of a-z, 0-9, `.`, `-`, `_`).

can_undo.description: This item's action is the latest one, so it can be undone.

safety_notes.description: What is already true, and what will be checked when the person installs.

designs.description: The designs the action added (designs, as `GET /designs/{id}` returns them).

StoreUndoRequest.description: Leave `token` out to undo the latest action. A `token` that is there (even null or empty) must be the latest's own: 400 `store_undo_bad_token` if it is not text, 404 `store_undo_unknown`, 409 `store_undo_out_of_order`; 409 `store_undo_conflict` when the user's own default look was edited since a removal put it back.

StudioEngineStats.description: Compositor metrics, active capture issues, output status, and per-source frame load.

file.description: Full local path of the saved PNG screenshot.

StudioSourceScreenshotRequest.description: Optional scene-item target. Provide both `scene` and `item` (here or as query parameters; omit both to capture the raw source).

StudioSourceStatus.description: Live health/status details for a source (`{}` when the source kind reports no live status).

StudioSourceStill.description: Picker thumbnail response for a display, window, or camera.

waiting.description: Present and true only when a camera is temporarily disconnected or waiting for its first frame.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped local API key (`fc_key_...`) or browser session token from `POST /api/v1/session/pair`.

info.description: Authenticate using a dashboard pairing token or a scoped local API key (`Authorization: Bearer fc_key_...`). Keys are hashed with SHA-256, rate-limited (120 req/min default), audited without storing the secret, and never permitted on PC-only secret, account, plugin, diagnostics, or key-management endpoints.
